title: Investment Analysts’ Updated EPS Estimates for January, 3rd (AAPL, AMRX, ASCL, BMY, CACC, CELG, CIG, EYE, FLS, GOOG)
text:
Investment Analysts’ updated eps estimates for Thursday, January 3rd:
Apple (NASDAQ:AAPL) was downgraded by analysts at Jefferies Financial Group Inc from a buy rating to a hold rating. Jefferies Financial Group Inc currently has $160.00 target price on the stock, down from their previous target price of $225.00. Get Apple Inc alerts:
Apple (NASDAQ:AAPL) had its price target reduced by Morgan Stanley from $236.00 to $211.00. The firm currently has an overweight rating on the stock.
Apple (NASDAQ:AAPL) had its outperform rating reiterated by analysts at Wedbush. They currently have a $200.00 price target on the stock, down from their previous price target of $275.00.
Apple (NASDAQ:AAPL) had its buy rating reiterated by analysts at Citigroup Inc. Citigroup Inc currently has a $170.00 price target on the stock.
Apple (NASDAQ:AAPL) had its price target reduced by Maxim Group from $212.00 to $160.00. They currently have a hold rating on the stock. They noted that the move was a valuation call. The analysts noted that the move was a valuation call.

Credit Acceptance (NASDAQ:CACC) was upgraded by analysts at Stephens from an underweight rating to an equal weight rating.
Celgene (NASDAQ:CELG) had its buy rating reissued by analysts at Cantor Fitzgerald. They currently have a $100.00 target price on the stock. The analysts wrote, “We think Celgene remains a show-me story to investors, which has the stock trading at a discount to peers. We are cautiously optimistic with management changes that execution is improving. We think that the base business remains strong for 2019, and we think filing key late-stage programs over 2019 will help get the stock back on track. The company has many late-stage programs like liso-cel, luspatercept, ozanimod in MS. bb2121 that could launch in late 19/early 2020. Valuation Summary We have a $100 PT on the shares.””
